title: Sentimental Graffiti
native_title: センチメンタル・グラフティ
overview:
I want to see you.

Sentimental Graffiti is a romance simulation adventure. Just before spring break of your third year of high school, an unsigned letter arrives with those words. Your family moved often when you were a child, and the sender could be any of twelve girls you once knew in twelve cities across Japan, from Sapporo to Nagasaki. Over the following year, set out from Tokyo on weekends and holidays to find them again. Work part-time to pay for the trip, choose between trains, planes, ferries, night buses or hitchhiking, decide where to stay, and phone ahead to set up dates - but arrive late and her feelings will cool, and leave a girl too long without word and she will grow lonely.

- Twelve heroines in twelve cities
- Single player
- Memory backup save
- Two discs

あなたに、会いたい。
